verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server (ZeroMCP) that lets agents drive the mailbox programmatically: read threads by ID, list folders, search and filter, compose and send, manage drafts, delete, bulk archive, and manage labels. However, this interface is an MCP tool surface rather than a general documented public REST/HTTP API. Authentication is limited to a Better Auth session token, with OAuth marked as 'coming soon'. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API (REST/OpenAPI reference), production-grade auth (OAuth/API keys), rate-limit and versioning docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works.
